registered_before: any read-level data were fetched or inspected (HG002 Q100, 1KG-ONT, CHM13 reads)
informed_by: CHM13 v2.0 reference properties only (D-P homology, diagnostic-site attrition, shared-sequence masks of the recipient ends)
frozen_before: held-out HG002 claims evaluated with these criteria
any 1KG-ONT carrier reads fetched or inspected
negative_control_definition: strictly native: raw mosaic structure only home/none on every haplotype contributing reads

calibration_changes.change: aligned-fraction integrity test unions genome-wide and reference-window alignments
calibration_changes.reason: minimap2 --secondary=no drops the donor-block alignment of carrier reads when it overlaps the primary on the read
calibration_changes.evidence: synthetic unit-test fixture; smoke test on HG002 4q paternal (ONT UL)

calibration_changes.change: for ONT R9.4.1 reads the terminal-telomere caller also accepts the published R9 telomere basecalling artefact motifs (CTTCTT, CCCTGG, TTTTAA and rotations; tip frame)
calibration_changes.reason: among 1KG-ONT native-control reads whose CHM13 alignment reaches within 3 kb of the chromosome end, 188/883 (21%) passed with canonical motifs and 637/883 (72%) with the artefact motifs
calibration_changes.evidence: work/readevidence/ont1kg native-control slices only (no carrier reads)

calibration_changes.change: switch concordance is tested against the claim's unit model applied to the person's assembly end window (error-free), falling back to the catalogue switch when that projection shows no switch; catalogue-switch concordance is still reported (switch_concordant_catalogue)
calibration_changes.reason: in the training half, conclusive carrier reads at 17p (both haplotypes), 19p paternal and 6q maternal placed the D/P switch tightly and unanimously 2-7 kb from the catalogue switch, which is a 5 kb sliding-identity boundary with a tie rule rather than a diagnostic-unit change point

calibration_changes.change: specificity is computed on strictly native controls; core-native controls (non-home raw blocks < 10 kb) are reported separately
calibration_changes.reason: all conclusive reads among core-native controls (HG002 19q paternal: structure 22q|4q|21q|home; 1KG HG00128/HG00133 19q, HG02976 9p) came from individuals whose assemblies carry short non-home raw blocks at the arm; 0 of 347 strictly native control reads were conclusive

true-carrier D-segment purity is as low as 0.80 (15q paternal, median 0.80; 3q paternal 0.85) because the person's donor-like haplotype itself differs from CHM13 D at some diagnostic sites; raising min_segment_purity would remove true carriers, and the control conclusives were explained by C3
